items.title: Inherited-fd serveBackend

evidence.notes: serveBackend now accepts inheritFd option; when set, uses server.listen({fd}) instead of create+bind+chmod; close() does NOT unlink socket file (did not create it); 4 new tests in backend.spec.ts: negative control, injectFd round-trip, multiple requests, file persistence

notes: backend.ts: inheritFd option on ServeBackendOptions; useInheritedFd branch skips mkdir/unlink/create/chmod; server.listen({fd}) for inherited fd; close() does not unlink socket file
backend.spec.ts: 4 tests — negative control (normal UDS path), inheritFd round-trip, multiple requests, behavioral verification (no file creation/unlink)
Negative-control invariant: when inheritFd is omitted (the normal case), the original create+bind+chmod path is unchanged — proven by negative control test
Socket fd dupping via /dev/fd/N (macOS) / /proc/self/fd/N (Linux) — works for socket fds on both platforms
